description: Faransati ba a’yo vu ambo Africa alia ka dunia dria, Paris ni ani Dakar, Kinshasa ka Montréal.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lugbara courses (#132) with low confidence in Lugbara; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: E’yo **vu ambo dunia dria ni.**
why.text: Faransati ba a’yo Africa, Europe, Canada ka vu ere alia. Imba geri ndizu ni, sukulu ni, azi ni, ka ongo, buku ka filim ni.

cards.title: Ba ndi geri dria ni
cards.text: Ndi Kinshasa ni ani Dakar, Paris ka Montréal.

cards.title: Azi ka sukulu
cards.text: Azi ngu vu ambo Faransati a’yo ni Africa alia be.

cards.title: Ba le e’yo ni ni
cards.text: Ndre bukuyi, ongoyi ka filim Faransati alia.

landing.audience: Ba Lugbarati a’yo ni etozu ni, anzi sukulu, azi bayi ka ba ndi vu Faransati a’yo ni.
landing.first: Ngoni, ru a’yozu ka nde, vutia aku ba, nyaka, suku, sawa, vu, jo ka ruakini, alu alu.

cast.emma: Uji vu ere ni a’yo Faransati
